cohort: 360 neonates at Cape Coast Teaching Hospital (CCTH) in Ghana from January 2018 to December 2021
finding: Neonatal factors associated with sepsis were low Apgar score and low birth weight, while maternal factors were maternal education, caesarean deliveries, maternal infection and foul-smelling liquor.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were associated with a lower risk of neonatal sepsis.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with neonatal sepsis
